errors.text_span: с етикети на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The x-axis has labels for every single year from 2001 to 2021, not every two years.

errors.text_span: Червената линия (BG40), свързана с дясната скала, започва от стойност около 100 през 2004 година
errors.evidence: The red line (BG40) starts in 2005, not 2004, and its starting value on the right scale is approximately 230, not 100.

errors.text_span: достига връх от около 1400 през 2007 година
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly reads the peak of the red line (BG40) from the left y-axis. According to its legend, it uses the right y-axis, where its peak value is approximately 450, not 1400.

errors.text_span: рязко спада до под 100 към 2009 година
errors.evidence: In 2009, the red line (BG40) drops to a value of approximately 180 on the right scale, not below 100.

errors.text_span: След 2010 година стойностите ѝ остават ниски, около или под 100, до края на периода.
errors.evidence: After 2010, the values for the red line (BG40) fluctuate between approximately 180 and 300 on the right scale; they never drop to or below 100.

errors.text_span: Зелената линия (BGBX40), също свързана с дясната скала, започва от около 100 през 2013 година
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) begins in the year 2014, not 2013.

errors.text_span: показва бавно покачване до около 200 към 2021 година
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) ends at a value of approximately 150 in 2021, not 200.
The description does not mention the tick mark intervals for the y-axes (every 200 units for the left axis, every 100 units for the right axis).
